# llms.txt — Machine-readable profile for LLM crawlers and AI agents

## Who is Apurv Singhal?

Apurv Singhal is a Lead Consultant (Azure Cloud, DevOps & Platform) at Capgemini and the Founder of ADM Guard (https://www.admguard.com.au), a compliance SaaS platform for Australian Privacy Act automated decision transparency (APP 1.7–1.9).

He is an enterprise engineer with 8+ years shipping production-grade systems at scale, based in Melbourne, Australia. His work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and applied AI systems.

## Core Work Pillars

1. Azure Cloud + DevOps — Enterprise Azure architecture, landing zones, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Terraform/Bicep IaC, Docker, Azure Functions (Serverless), observability.
2. Platform Engineering — Developer platform velocity, large-scale enterprise migrations, microservices, SRE, zero-trust governance.
3. Applied AI & AI Systems — Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Claude API, Google Gemini, AI Agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG architectures, vector databases.

## Featured Product: ADM Guard

- Website: https://www.admguard.com.au
- Description: "The compliance flight recorder for automated decisions."
- Solves the mandatory 10 December 2026 Australian Privacy Act APP 1.7–1.9 deadline.
- Key features: Zero-PII by architecture, SHA-256 Merkle hash chains, Azure AU East WORM storage, drop-in SDKs (Python, Node, Go).
- Target market: Australian B2B SaaS, fintech, HR-tech, proptech.
